input.command:
S=/private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-vitaliy-Documents-GitHub-local-whisper/881e21dc-c26e-4f4f-865e-0d78e8553961/scratchpad
REF=$(cat "$S/ref.txt")
VOL=$(osascript -e 'output volume of (get volume settings)'); osascript -e 'set volume output volume 80'
rm -rf "$S/e2e_old"; mkdir -p "$S/e2e_old"
/usr/local/bin/ffmpeg -nostdin -hide_banner -loglevel error -f avfoundation -i :default -ac 1 -ar 16000 \
   -f segment -segment_time 1 -segment_format wav "$S/e2e_old/chunk_%03d.wav" > "$S/old.log" 2>&1 &
FP=$!
sleep 1.2; say -v Milena -r 180 "$REF"; sleep 1.0
kill -INT $FP; wait $FP 2>/dev/null
osascript -e "set volume output volume $VOL"
ls -l "$S/e2e_old"/*.wav | awk '{s+=$5;n++} END {printf "old: files=%d audio=%.2fs\n", n, (s-n*44)/32000}'
echo "per-chunk (old): "; for f in $(ls "$S/e2e_old"/*.wav | head -4); do printf "  "; /usr/local/bin/ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$f"; done
